home.pitch: The first AI Consensus Platform that combines the best reasoning from multiple AI models into one transparent answer.

strategyHint.max_accuracy: Prioritise verified facts and cite consensus above novelty.
strategyHint.balanced: Even weight on accuracy, nuance and clarity.
strategyHint.creative: Reward unexpected framings and lateral connections.
strategyHint.critical: Actively surface counter-arguments and edge cases.
strategyHint.fast: Shortest defensible answer with the top argument.

home.emptyError: Ask something first — the referee can't judge silence.
home.howTitle: From your question to a conclusion you can trust
home.howBody: Every step is transparent — you always see what the models agreed on, disagreed on, and why.
home.modelsTitle: The world's best AIs, in the same room
home.modelsBody: Referee sends your question to each in parallel — and only shows you what they agree on.

evidence.title: Evidence Review
evidence.body: Claims are checked for logical consistency.

challenge.title: Challenge Conclusion
challenge.body: Optionally stress-test it against every model.

updated.title: Updated Conclusion
updated.body: The conclusion evolves as evidence changes.

home.featureAbody: GPT, Gemini and Mistral reason on your question in parallel. Claude and Grok are on the roadmap.
home.featureBbody: Every conclusion ships with a consensus level and a defensible confidence score.
home.featureCbody: One click asks every model to try to refute the conclusion — and update it.
home.pricingBody: Start free with OpenAI, Gemini and Mistral. Upgrade to add Claude, priority processing and higher limits — or bring your own keys.

free.name: Free
free.tagline: Everything you need to compare OpenAI, Gemini and Mistral with Smart Reuse and full transparency.
free.f1: Trusted Conclusion from GPT + Gemini + Mistral
free.f2: Smart Reuse — cached answers in your language

premium.name: Premium
premium.tagline: Four-model consensus with Claude, higher confidence, priority processing and 200 daily comparisons.
premium.f4: Early access to Grok and future providers

byok.name: Bring Your Own Keys
byok.tagline: One-time purchase that lets you plug your own OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Grok or Mistral keys. Requests never touch AI Referee credits.
byok.f1: Use your own OpenAI / Gemini / Claude keys
byok.f2: Zero platform-side API cost — you pay your provider directly
byok.f3: Keys encrypted at rest, never exposed to the frontend
byok.f4: Effectively unlimited comparisons (subject to your provider quotas)

reuse.title: You've asked something similar before.
reuse.subtitle: Referee found a prior Trusted Conclusion that overlaps with your question. Reuse it for an instant answer, or run a fresh multi-model comparison to update it.
reuse.caveat: Reused conclusions cite the original model responses. Refreshing charges a full multi-model comparison and overwrites the cache.

debate.demoDescription: A simulated transcript used only to demonstrate the debate experience.
debate.liveDescription: LIVE execution shows only data returned by the providers.
debate.unavailableDescription: AI Referee does not fabricate a debate transcript during LIVE execution.
debate.demoVerdictDescription: The demo models aligned on the example framing. The simulated conclusion is ready.

settings.title: Preferences
settings.reuseHint: Referee caches prior Trusted Conclusions and offers to reuse them when you ask a similar question.
settings.prefAskHint: Referee will show the Reusable Consensus screen every time a match is found.
settings.prefFreshHint: Skip the reuse prompt and run a new multi-model comparison by default.
settings.prefReusedHint: Automatically reuse a matching prior conclusion when one exists within the cache window.
settings.prefSensitiveHint: Always run fresh comparisons for financial, legal, medical and current-event topics. Other topics may still be reused.

results.whyBody: Every claim is sorted by how much support it earned from the models. Nothing is hidden.
results.contributionTitle: How each model shaped the conclusion
results.whyChoseAnswer: Why did AI Referee choose this answer?
results.noConclusion: The Trusted Conclusion is not available for this reused answer. Refresh with a new comparison to generate it.
results.rationaleBody: Three concise explanations for why this conclusion beats every alternative Referee considered.
results.reusedExplainer: This Trusted Conclusion was served instantly from Referee's consensus cache. No new AI comparison was run.
results.updatedExplainer: You had a matching prior conclusion, but you asked Referee to refresh with a new AI comparison. The cache has been updated.
results.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this browser.
results.defaultPrompt: What is a distributed database and why would I use one?
results.whyStillValuable: Why it may still be valuable
results.roadmapProviders: Claude and Grok are planned for future releases.
results.transparencyNote: This conclusion is generated from the strongest consensus among the available model responses. It supports decision-making and does not replace human judgment.
results.evidenceNote: The Evidence Meter combines model agreement, logical consistency, reasoning quality, citation availability and confidence.
results.citationLookupSoon: Live citation lookup is not available yet.
results.evolutionBody: From your question to the final verdict — every phase remains visible.

errors.requestNotCreated: The comparison request could not be created.
errors.providerFailureDetail: The provider did not complete the request. Please try again shortly.
errors.apiKeyMissing: The provider API key is not configured.
errors.authenticationFailed: Provider authentication failed. Check the API key.
errors.quotaExceeded: The provider usage limit or available quota has been reached.
errors.networkError: The provider could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unknownExecutionStatus: The provider returned an unknown execution status.
errors.mockBlocked: Simulated content was blocked during live execution.
errors.queryNotFound: The comparison request is no longer available.
errors.noProviderResponse: The provider did not return a response.

providers.premiumDescription: {model} will join the panel when this provider becomes available.
providers.roadmapDescription: {model} is on the roadmap and will not be called until its integration is active.

question.title: Question
question.body: You asked a single, specific question.

consensus.title: Consensus formation
consensus.body: Agreements, disagreements and uncertainty were compared side by side.

challenge.title: Critical review
challenge.body: The current conclusion was examined for flaws and missing context.

verdict.title: Final verdict
verdict.body: The strongest supportable answer is shown with its evidence and limits.

rationaleItems.title: Strongest shared evidence
rationaleItems.body: The conclusion prioritizes the points supported most consistently across the available responses.

rationaleItems.title: Conflicts resolved during comparison
rationaleItems.body: When the models disagree, Referee presents the competing positions instead of silently choosing one.

rationaleItems.title: Remaining uncertainty
rationaleItems.body: Open questions and limitations stay visible so the conclusion is not presented as absolute truth.

structured.claimDetailsTooltip: Open the provider explanations, Referee assessment and evidence limitations.
structured.disagreementDescription: This section appears only when providers support genuinely different positions.
structured.missingInformation: Missing information that could resolve the disagreement
structured.keyFindingsDescription: Each finding is linked to the provider responses and source references that support or challenge it.
structured.providerAssessmentDescription: This assessment reflects only the supplied responses. It is not an external accuracy audit.
structured.sourcesNotice: These sources were indicated by the models and were not externally verified by AI Referee.
structured.claimMatrixDescription: Each material claim is compared across the providers that participated in this result.
structured.exclusiveContributionsDescription: Useful points introduced by one provider only; uniqueness does not make them verified.
structured.decisiveFactorsDescription: The evidence that had the greatest influence on the final verdict.

traceability.title: Why this verdict
traceability.description: See which provider response supports each important claim and which sources the providers explicitly mentioned.

verification.invalid_url: Invalid or unsafe URL — not clickable
verification.missing_url: Provider named the source without a URL

install.iosBody: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
